gates.name: Cool H/He recombination coverage
gates.scope: Nine / nineteen 3000-12000 K, 10-90% neutral-H cells in the 84 / 167-radius T6 controls. Coverage only, not equilibrium or a physical envelope.

gates.name: Cool non-LTE nonlinear, thermal and energy validation
gates.scope: T9 NaN/zero-correction crash and runaway-J Newton continuation. T6 coarse/refined electron residuals 150.59/150.57%, global radiation defects 8.6847/1.9309%, cumulative interior defects 14.8590/6.4093%. Fixed-temperature Lambda sequences remain severely unconverged. No converged cool reference reproduction.

gates.name: H-minus native output and Rayleigh implementation repairs
gates.scope: Name-based output invariant under matched inputs; actual native Rayleigh call/HI population derivative passes analytic fixture. Original failures retained; no claim of full atmosphere certification.

gates.name: Thermodynamically consistent material/radiation response
gates.scope: Exact ideal resolved-atom frozen-population and population-energy partials pass. Relaxed non-LTE response, consistent dissolution/nonideal terms and shared envelope mass/energy conventions are not validated; insufficient for production wind.

gates.name: Global nonlocal force/heating and mass-loss eigenvalue
gates.scope: No reliable derivatives can be constructed from the failed cool states. No production mdot or sonic solution selected.

gates.name: Conservative convective-envelope handoff
gates.scope: No validated overlap or stress/transport/dissipation closure. Mach-one MLT guard remains enabled and tested.

gates.name: One physical envelope selecting a conservative escaping wind
gates.scope: Not attempted because prerequisite cool/material/nonlocal/handoff gates fail. No physical no-wind theorem claimed.

gates.name: Coupled evolution and complete published evolutionary benchmark
gates.scope: Downstream prerequisites failed; zero new physical evolution or published full-track replicas.

gates.name: Cool mesh/frequency and response convergence
gates.scope: 84/167-radius cool controls both fail nonlinear and thermal convergence. Smaller radiation error does not establish mesh convergence; frequency/response-step convergence not certified.

gates.name: Nonfinite rejection and retained failure/restart evidence
gates.scope: NaN diagnostics cannot masquerade as zero-correction convergence. Setup failures, native instabilities and original inputs retained. This is software failure handling, not physical restart validation.

gates.name: Apple Silicon and cloud readiness
gates.scope: 84/167-radius cool components take 1041.17/2008.61 s with 121.75/181.69 MiB peak footprint locally. Failures occur without resource exhaustion; no cloud run needed to establish failure. Global wind and Linux/cloud numerical/scaling validation remain unmeasured.

gates.name: QStarS v1 / QSRD
gates.scope: General-purpose independent v1 prerequisites remain unsatisfied. QSRD deferred.
